caseName: International Business Machines Corp. v. Federal Communications Commission
caseNameFull: International Business Machines Corp. v. Federal Communications Commission and American Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Federal Communications Commission
judges: Blackmun, Certio, Consideration, Petitions, Rari, Took

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice White would grant certio-rari. Mr. Justice Blackmun and Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.

Reported below: 572 F. 2d 17.
